title: Vladimir Fedorovitch Komarnitsky - Applicant For Enlistment In Russian Company S.V.C

page_data.en:
Fin. 2
G. 350-11-32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. File No. 5-15
Special Branch S. 4 1/2 12/33
REPORT
Date December 4, 1933.

Subject (in full) Vladimir Fedorovitch Komarnitsky, Applicant for enlistment
in Russian Company S.V.C.

Made by D.S. Tcheremahansky Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the attached enrollment form of
Vladimir Fedorovitch Komarnitsky, enquiries show that he is
a Russian, born on October 3, 1915 at Habarovsk, Siberia.
He went to Pogranichnaia Station C.E.R. accompanied by his
parents in 1921 and remained there until 1926. From 1926 until
1930 he resided at Harbin and was educated at the "Realnoe"
(Middle School). In 1930 he came to Shanghai and is employed
for over two years with the China General Omnibus Co., 263
Connaught Road as an apprentice-mechanic.

Komarnitsky's father is a merchant and is a proprietor
of restaurant by occupation. When he was in Harbin he opened
the "Dejurny" Restaurant. In 1930 he established the Summer
Box Cafe, No.314 A, Broadway, Shanghai. At present he is
keeping a boarding house at Terrace No.260, House 7 Chaoufoong
Road.

V. Komarnitsky is registered with the Russian Emi-
grants Committee. He resides at Terrace No.260, House 7 Chau-
foong Road. Nothing is known in this office against the
applicant.

[Signature]
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

S2, Please inform S.V.C.
confidentially of contents of this
report which might be shown to
Adjutant.
[Signature]

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
刑事与特别股登记处。
档案编号 5-15
特别股 S. 4 1/2 12/33
报告
日期：1933年12月4日。

主题（全称）弗拉基米尔·费奥多罗维奇·科马尔尼茨基（Vladimir Fedorovitch Komarnitsky），申请加入俄国连（S.V.C.）

由 D.S. 切列马汉斯基（Tcheremahansky）呈报 转交人 [签名]

关于随附的弗拉基米尔·费奥多罗维奇·科马尔尼茨基的入伍申请表，经查询，其为俄国人，1915年10月3日出生于西伯利亚哈巴罗夫斯克（Habarovsk）。1921年，他随父母前往中东铁路（C.E.R.）的波格拉尼奇纳亚站（Pogranichnaia Station），并在那里停留至1926年。1926年至1930年间，他居住在哈尔滨，并在“实科”中学（"Realnoe" Middle School）接受教育。1930年，他来到上海，在康纳路（Connaught Road）263号的中国通用汽车公司（China General Omnibus Co.）担任学徒机械师，已工作两年有余。

科马尔尼茨基的父亲是一名商人，职业为餐馆业主。在哈尔滨期间，他开设了“德茹尔尼”（Dejurny）餐馆。1930年，他在上海百老汇路（Broadway）314 A号创办了“夏盒咖啡馆”（Summer Box Cafe）。目前，他在兆丰路（Chaoufoong Road）7号露台260号经营一家寄宿公寓。

V. 科马尔尼茨基已在俄侨委员会注册。他居住在兆丰路（Chaufoong Road）7号露台260号。本处未发现对该申请人不利的记录。

[签名]
D. S.
特别股主管警官。

S2，请将本报告内容机密地通知俄国连（S.V.C.），该报告可出示给副官。
[签名]
